title: Element Categories
short: Metals, nonmetals, metalloids — which is which?
trouble: Confusing the symbol's language (Latin names) with the English name.

blocks.html: The periodic table is a map you can read. This drill works on metals, nonmetals, metalloids — which is which?.
Tip: Metals fill the left and middle, nonmetals top right, and the metalloids form the staircase between them.
Questions are generated from the published element data — the same numbers the Periodic table dataset shows.
